提示词：

【城市】：____
【城市面貌 A】：____
【城市面貌 B】：____
【A 侧代表元素】：____
【B 侧代表元素】：____
【A 侧主色】：____
【B 侧主色】：____
【主标题】：____
【英文副标题】：____

创作一张 9:16 高级城市概念海报，把同一座城市最有代表性的两种面貌、时代、地理或空间特征压进同一个画面。

画面建立两个彼此对望的城市世界：A 侧从画面一侧向中央密集生长，B 侧从另一侧向中央延伸，两侧拥有各自完整的建筑、道路、交通、人物和城市生活细节。通过夸张但可信的空间关系，让城市像从两个方向共同挤压、包围中央区域，形成强烈尺度感、纵深感和城市奇观。

两侧不能只是换颜色，而要通过建筑语言、时代特征、地理环境、交通方式、生活细节和光线真正体现【城市面貌 A】与【城市面貌 B】之间的关系。每一侧设置一个清晰的主视觉地标，其余城市元素逐级退后，形成近景、中景、远景和完整城市天际线。

中央保留一条较窄的天空、雾气、水域或城市裂隙作为视觉缓冲，两侧环境可适度伸入中央，使画面紧张但不混乱。整体采用高密度细节 × 清晰视觉层级，远看具有冲击力，近看能够发现有意义的城市信息。

标题【主标题】融入中央空间，字体设计应根据城市本身的性格重新设计，可参考碑刻、Art Deco、窄体城市字体、现代宋体或几何字体语言，而不是简单放置普通文字。只保留【英文副标题】等真正解释作品含义的信息，不加入随机英文、假参数、编号或无意义装饰文字。

保持写实城市质感与高级 Editorial Design 气质，建筑材质、道路、灯光、窗户、人物尺度和空气透视真实细腻；色彩由两种城市面貌的主题决定，在中央自然过渡。

重点：让海报首先是一件完整的城市视觉作品，每一个建筑、文字、色彩和细节都服务于城市主题，而不是模板化填充。

【地点与日期】：【填写】

生成一张 9:16 竖版东方留白艺术海报，将【修养箴言】转化为具有当代装置感的视觉隐喻。

使用带有真实纤维、压痕和纸浆颗粒的高级手工艺术纸作为背景，保留大面积留白，并加入与主题有关的低对比浅浮雕【背景压纹】。压纹必须参与表达含义，远看克制，近看才发现细节。

画面设置一个轮廓清晰、具有真实体积和材质触感的【主体材料】，通过【视觉隐喻】表现【核心含义】。加入一个占画面约 1%—2% 的极小人物，建立巨物与人的尺度关系。

色彩使用【主色体系】，可以大胆、鲜明，但保持明确主次。让颜色通过釉光、裂隙、倒影、流光、漆面或材料内部进入空间，不要始终局限于黑白灰，也不要使用廉价霓虹特效。

中文主标题使用【两字主题】，采用现代宋体、明朝体或雕刻感衬线字体。可以通过字距、错位、弧线或短线增加设计感，但必须保证汉字完整、准确、清晰。

同时加入小字号的【修养箴言】、地点、日期和简短英文标题。整体呈现东方修养、材料艺术、当代装置与高级编辑海报的结合。

prompts.text:
GPT Image 2 on Chat GPT

Prompt:

Create a premium cinematic GRAPHIC DESIGN promotional poster in a modern professional creative-studio aesthetic.

COMPOSITION:
Vertical 4:5 portrait format. Create a highly polished, realistic graphic-design advertisement/poster. The composition should feel like a professional Behance/Dribbble creative artwork mixed with a cinematic movie poster.

At the very top, place huge bold uppercase typography:

“GRAPHIC
DESIGN”

Use extremely thick, condensed, rounded sans-serif lettering, white, clean, powerful, perfectly centered. The typography should dominate the upper section without covering the main character.

Directly underneath, add a smaller elegant quote:

“Great creativity comes with great responsibility”

Use clean white/light-gray typography with subtle cinematic glow.

MAIN SUBJECT:
Place the main character prominently in the center of the composition, from approximately waist/chest level upward.

The character should have a confident, creative, professional pose, holding a large professional graphic-design tool/tablet/interface element diagonally across the body.

Make the subject look highly detailed and photorealistic, with realistic materials, sharp textures, natural shadows, dramatic studio lighting, and cinematic depth.

The character should visually represent a modern digital artist / graphic designer.

BACKGROUND:
Behind the character, create a large curved computer monitor displaying a professional graphic-design software interface.

The monitor should look like a real modern desktop design workstation with:
- dark Photoshop-style interface
- layers panel
- tools panel
- color picker
- adjustment panels
- typography controls
- editing workspace
- blurred design elements
- realistic monitor reflections

Keep the software interface slightly out of focus so the main character remains the visual focus.

Add subtle perspective distortion to the monitor, making it feel like the character is standing inside a professional creative workstation.

SURROUNDING GRAPHIC ELEMENTS:
Place floating 3D graphic-design icons around the character.

Include:
- Photoshop-style “Ps” icon
- Illustrator-style “Ai” icon
- digital pen tool symbol
- vector-path handles
- selection boxes
- anchor points
- crop/transform symbols
- typography symbols
- geometric design elements
- subtle UI interface fragments

The icons should appear as realistic floating 3D objects with subtle reflections, shadows and depth.

Place one glowing blue Photoshop-style icon toward the upper-right side.

Place another Photoshop-style icon toward the lower-left side.

Place a warm orange Illustrator-style icon toward the lower-right side.

Do not make the icons oversized. They should complement the composition rather than overpower the main character.

DESIGN OVERLAY:
Add subtle white vector lines, geometric construction shapes, Bézier curves, anchor points, selection rectangles and technical graphic-design guides throughout the background.

Some lines should overlap the monitor and extend around the character, creating the feeling of a professional designer's workspace.

Add a large thin white transform/selection bounding box around the central artwork.

Include small vector anchor points and handles around the right side of the composition.

LIGHTING:
Dark cinematic studio environment.

Use dramatic rim lighting around the character.

Strong controlled highlights on the edges of the subject.

Soft volumetric light coming from behind.

Subtle blue and white glow from the computer interface.

Warm orange glow from the Illustrator icon.

Deep blacks, rich shadows and controlled highlights.

Professional commercial photography lighting.

Ultra-realistic reflections and shadows.

DEPTH:
Use strong foreground, middle-ground and background separation.

Foreground elements should have slight depth-of-field blur.

The central character must remain extremely sharp.

The computer interface should be slightly blurred.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】  
【主视觉主体】  
【中文核心字】  
【中文标题】  
【英文标题】  
【对角机制】跨界变形 / 摄影转印刷 / 透明叠层 / 重复透视 / 其他  
【视觉状态变化】摄影→图形 / 彩色→单色 / 实体→折射 / 近大→远小 / 其他  
【主色】  
【强调色】  
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 **Experimental Japanese Graphic Design、East Asian Contemporary Poster、Editorial Art Direction、Photo Graphic Design** 气质的实验性竖版海报。核心继续使用“对角构图”，但不要只依靠一条斜线切画面，而是让主体、色域、透明层、重复元素或空间序列沿隐形对角轴发生变化，使对角关系本身成为视觉实验。

先根据【主题】选择一种最适合的对角机制。单一物件可以跨越两个色域，并在越过边界后从真实摄影转化为平面图形；植物、人物等有机主体可以穿越斜向色块，在不同区域改变颜色、网点或印刷状态；透明材质可以从近到远沿对角轴叠加，通过折射、遮挡和尺度变化建立空间；多个重复元素可以通过“近大远小、前后遮挡、姿态变化”沿斜轴推进，让观众在没有真实斜线的情况下仍然清楚感受到方向。

这类海报最重要的是“跨界以后发生什么”。至少设计一个明显但合理的视觉状态变化，例如真实摄影进入色域后变成丝网印刷剪影、同一物体经过透明层后出现折射错位、纸页沿对角方向由近到远逐渐缩小，或主体经过边界以后从彩色变成黑白。变化必须与构图产生因果关系，不要使用随机 glitch、RGB 分离或无意义特效。

对角色域要依赖大形而不是小装饰。可以使用两块高纯色域碰撞、一块大色域加窄负空间、透明板前后叠层，或大面积深色背景衬托重复对象。主体或主要视觉区域建议占画面约 50%–70%，颜色控制在 2–4 个主要层级，同一张只建立一个最强色彩关系。大胆使用群青、酸黄、朱红、深紫、冷白等现代印刷色，但不要平均分散颜色。

Typography 必须继续遵守“主体动，文字稳”。中文核心字、作品标题、英文标题保持水平或垂直，可大胆放大、贴边、裁切和跨区，但不要全部跟着对角线旋转。英文可以使用 Condensed Sans、Neo-Grotesk、Bold Serif 等现代字体，小信息使用 Neutral Grotesk。允许 Typography 与主体发生一处真实遮挡、穿插或前后关系，但必须保证标题仍然清晰可读。

可以适度加入 **halftone、screenprint、offset grain、轻微套印误差、粗网点摄影** 等印刷质感，使画面更像艺术书、独立出版、设计节海报，而不是普通数字海报。但不要做成朋克拼贴、撕纸、脏旧报纸或过度 grunge。画面要大胆、年轻、实验，同时保持清楚的大形和高级的版式控制。

信息密度保持中等。视觉复杂度主要来自主体状态变化、对角方向、色域关系、透明层或重复透视，而不是大量文字模块。至少保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，让高密视觉区域与安静区域形成节奏。辅助文字只保留标题、副标题、短句、日期、地点和 3–4 个主题关键词即可。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼先看到强烈的大色域或对角主体，第二眼发现主体跨界后的视觉状态变化，第三眼理解透明层、重复透视或摄影与图形之间的关系，最后才阅读标题和少量信息。整体效果应像东京实验设计展、独立艺术书、国际 Graphic Design 年鉴或高级 Editorial Art Direction，而不是普通产品广告或对角模板。

避免：只把主体斜着摆、标准 45° 分割、所有文字都倾斜、双色模板换皮、数字 glitch、RGB 色散、科技 HUD、PPT 时间轴、过多说明文字、无意义英文、Design Study、Vol.、编号、Logo、二维码和版权标识。

prompts.text:
These 4 posters were generated with one prompt. Ran it 4 times. Get 4 different results. This is what I have been working for months. The most advanced prompting system which hits 9.8/10 rating according to GPT 5.6

Generator + solver + evaluator architecture: 9.8/10

The prompt is complex. Wouldn't fit but it can generate 200k styles  Here is something you can use to generate somewhat similar posters: 

class HistoricalExperiencePoster:
    def __init__(self, topic):
        self.topic = topic

        self.event_dna = infer_core_story(topic)
        self.moment = infer_visual_turning_point(topic)
        self.hero_action = infer_embodied_action(self.moment)

        self.title = derive_monumental_title(topic)
        self. date = infer_time_marker(topic)
        self. place = infer_location(topic)
        self.thesis = derive_emotional_thesis(topic)

        self.experiences = infer_participatory_activities(
            topic,
            count="1..3",
            criteria=[
                "culturally appropriate",
                "visually iconable",
                "helps audience engage with topic"
            ]
        )

        self.values = infer_core_values(topic, count="2..4")
        self.landmarks = infer_environmental_anchors(topic)

    def historical_layer(self):
        return {
            "hero_scene": reconstruct(self.moment),
            "action": self.hero_action,
            "landmarks": self.landmarks,
            "crowd": infer_if_needed(self.topic)
        }

    def experience_layer(self):
        return {
            "activities": self.experiences,
            "icons": [infer_icon(x) for x in self.experiences],
            "values": self.values
        }

    def render(self):
        return """
        Fuse historical cinematic realism with distressed typography,
        neon activity signage, iconography, and contemporary event-poster hierarchy.
        """

Create a 9:16 editorial poster based on a fan-shaped composition, with an emphasis on curved structures, flowing movement, and strong visual rhythm.

SUBJECT: [your subject]

CONCEPT: [core idea or mood]
FAN LOGIC: [flowing ribbon / offset arcs / radial burst / motion arcs / mixed curved fan structure]
VISUAL MATERIALS: [photography / collage / textures / painting / architecture / people / objects]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–4 main colors]

Prioritize graceful visual movement. Let the composition guide the eye through the poster with ribbons, arcs, layered curved sections, or a single radial burst used in a more expressive way.

The shape should help express the idea:

* a flowing ribbon can suggest wind, motion, transition, or invisible force
* offset arcs can suggest observation, rhythm, memory, or layered perception
* a radial burst can suggest sound, signal, speed, or urban energy

Build a strong large silhouette first, then fill it with controlled visual variety. Mix image sections, pure color areas, negative space, and small editorial details so the poster feels designed rather than template-based.

Allow some elements to break across the fan boundaries when useful. Curves should feel intentional and elegant, not decorative for their own sake.

Typography should feel integrated into the composition. Use one clear title, a short supporting line, and a small amount of editorial text. Keep the copy meaningful and concise.

The final poster should feel like an art-forward editorial collage: visually striking from a distance, but richer and more layered up close.

Prompt:

【Theme】
【Title】
【Main typography】
【Spatial metaphor】
【Signature structure】

【Human activity】

Create a 9:16 vertical experimental editorial architecture poster that transforms the selected abstract concept into a monumental surreal spatial environment.

Do not simply design a building and place typography over it. The architecture itself must be generated from the logic of the concept.

Translate the theme into one clear spatial metaphor. Transit can become disconnected suspended platforms and passages. Time can become arcs, sunlight, long shadows and observation structures. Sound can become acoustic ribs, suspended panels and reverberation spaces. Memory can become fragmented rooms, doors, corridors and traces of human presence. For other themes, invent an equally direct architectural metaphor rather than reusing these examples mechanically.

Choose one dominant architectural gesture and build the entire composition around it. Avoid combining too many structural ideas. The image should have one immediately recognizable spatial identity even at small thumbnail size.

Integrate the main typography physically into the architecture. Large words, numbers or data should exist on different walls, platforms, curved surfaces, rooms or structural elements, following real perspective, scale, cropping, depth and occlusion. Typography may stretch across multiple spatial planes or only become readable from the chosen camera viewpoint. Never treat the main text as a flat graphic overlay.

Use the main typography as the visual hook. It should be simple enough to read quickly but surprising enough to make the viewer notice how it interacts with the space.

Add only a limited amount of secondary editorial information related to the theme, such as functional labels, measurements, timestamps, room information, observation data or short conceptual phrases. Keep many large surfaces completely blank so the design does not become a wall of text.

Populate the architecture with approximately 7 to 12 tiny adult human figures. Their poses should be natural and connected to the theme: waiting, walking, observing, listening, sitting, arriving or leaving. Keep people visually small so they establish scale, distance and emotional atmosphere rather than becoming portrait subjects.

Use large differences in architectural scale. Combine one or two monumental foreground structures with medium depth elements and several extremely small distant forms. Preserve clear foreground, middle ground and background separation.

Create strong but believable light and shadow. Let light participate in the concept whenever relevant: long shadows for time, isolated warm rooms for memory, controlled pools of light for sound, or directional daylight for transit. Avoid decorative cinematic effects that do not serve the spatial idea.

Use a restrained palette of ivory white, pale concrete gray, graphite black and soft desaturated atmospheric tones. Introduce only one muted accent color on a small percentage of the architecture so each variation develops its own identity while remaining part of the same series.

Use matte concrete, stone, glass or paper like architectural surfaces with subtle grain, graphite texture and delicate scan noise. Keep the final image closer to a sophisticated architecture publication, cultural poster or experimental editorial print than a glossy CGI render.

Maintain strong asymmetry, deliberate negative space and controlled information density. Avoid conventional presentation boards, regular grids and perfectly balanced layouts. The composition should feel carefully designed but never mechanically templated.

The final result should feel monumental, intelligent, surreal, quiet and slightly melancholic, with typography, architecture, tiny humans, light and spatial depth operating as one coherent visual system.

Prompt: 
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 underrated Low-Glycemic Index meals:  CREATE VIEW dish_dissection AS
WITH blueprint AS (
  SELECT
    '$DISH' AS dish,
    infer_layer_count('$DISH') AS n_layers,
    infer_construction_layers('$DISH') AS layers,   -- ordered outer→core
    infer_cut_surface('$DISH') AS cut_plane,
    infer_hero_core('$DISH') AS core_component,
    infer_thermal_profile('$DISH') AS temps
),
layer_table AS (
  SELECT
    ordinality AS layer_order,
    (layer->>'component')      AS component,
    (layer->>'thickness')      AS thickness_mm,
    (layer->>'color')          AS color,
    (layer->>'texture')        AS texture,
    (layer->>'structural_role')AS function,
    (layer->>'state')          AS thermal_state
  FROM blueprint,
       unnest(layers) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(layer, ordinality)
  ORDER BY layer_order DESC
),
render_specs AS (
  SELECT
    infer_camera_angle(cut_plane)          AS instruction_1,
    infer_lighting('$DISH')                AS instruction_2,  -- ring / raking / bounced, per dish
    infer_aperture('$DISH')                AS instruction_3,
    infer_motion_styling('$DISH')          AS instruction_4,  -- juice, steam, crumb, glaze, drip
    infer_background_mode('$DISH')         AS instruction_5,
    infer_annotation_system('$DISH')       AS instruction_6,  -- leader lines, Helvetica, grid
    infer_color_grading('$DISH')           AS instruction_7,
    infer_measurement_overlay('$DISH')     AS instruction_8,
    infer_thermal_overlay('$DISH')         AS instruction_9
  FROM blueprint
)
SELECT
  render_cutaway(
    dish := dish,
    layer_stack := json_agg(layer_table ORDER BY layer_order DESC),
    annotations := instruction_6,
    measurements := instruction_8,
    thermal_overlay := instruction_9,
    camera := instruction_1,
    lighting := instruction_2,
    aperture := instruction_3,
    styling := instruction_4,
    background := instruction_5,
    grading := instruction_7,
    format := '8K macro photography, surgical precision meets gourmet'
  ) AS final_image
FROM blueprint, render_specs, layer_table
GROUP BY dish, instruction_1, instruction_2, instruction_3,
         instruction_4, instruction_5, instruction_6, instruction_7,
         instruction_8, instruction_9;
RETURN final_image;

Create a 9:16 cinematic portrait poster built around atmosphere, light, reflection and emotional typography.

Start with a strong film-like portrait rather than a posed fashion photo. The subject should feel caught inside a real moment — looking through glass, standing in reflected city light, separated by shadow, or partially hidden by the environment. Keep natural skin texture, believable hair, expressive eyes and realistic lighting.

Use one main visual interference to shape the mood. This could be rain on glass, an incomplete reflection, a strong light leak, hard leaf shadows, a split moment between two portraits, soft bloom or controlled foreground blur. The effect should change how the portrait is perceived rather than simply decorate it.

Let part of the image remain clear while another part becomes hazy, reflected, overexposed or partially obscured. Controlled imperfection is important — the viewer should not see everything immediately.

Keep the color grading cinematic and distinctive. Cool blue, cyan, moss green, olive, steel grey or other restrained tones can dominate, while skin remains natural. Avoid muddy shadows and overly yellow or orange grading.

Typography should behave like part of the image. Mix an elegant serif or clean sans serif with one expressive handwritten phrase. Let text cross reflections, fade into light, overlap faces, extend beyond the frame or move across two photographic layers. Do not place every line neatly in empty space.

Keep supporting copy minimal — one strong title, one handwritten phrase and one short emotional sentence are enough.

The final image should feel somewhere between a film still, an art-house movie poster and a fashion editorial: atmospheric, intimate, visually layered and emotionally unresolved.

Avoid generic portrait layouts, excessive small text, rigid sidebars, fake movie credits, heavy UI graphics, random effects, image numbering, Vol./Issue labels, four-point sparkle symbols, logos and watermarks.

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 editorial collage poster built around a fan-shaped composition where the geometry directly expresses the concept.

SUBJECT: [your theme / subject]
TITLE: [main title]
CONCEPT: [what the poster should communicate]
FAN STRUCTURE: [layered curved fan / concentric arcs / large color wedges / radial burst / custom variation]
VISUAL CONTENT: [people / places / events / objects / moments / textures]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–5 dominant colors]
TYPOGRAPHY: [editorial serif / grotesk / condensed sans / mixed system]
BACKGROUND: [paper tone / flat color / minimal backdrop]
TEXT DETAILS: [short meaningful phrases / optional event or editorial information]

Choose the fan structure according to the meaning of the poster rather than using it as decoration.

For example:

* layered curved fans can suggest distance, travel, space, or unfolding experience
* concentric arcs can suggest emotion, perception, memory, or inner states
* large color wedges can organize communities, events, contrasting themes, or parallel worlds
* sharp radial cuts can suggest time, speed, simultaneous moments, or explosive energy

Build one clear large-scale composition first. From a distance, the fan geometry should be immediately readable and visually striking; up close, the viewer should discover richer photography, people, environments, textures, and narrative details.

Do not make every section equal. Vary the width, scale, density, and direction of the fan areas. Mix image-heavy sections with pure color fields and negative space to create rhythm.

Photography should adapt to the geometry rather than sit inside rectangular frames. Use bold cropping, scale shifts, partial subjects, layered imagery, and a few controlled elements crossing the boundaries when useful.

Keep each major section visually coherent with its own dominant color or tonal identity. The overall palette should feel intentional, not randomly multicolored.

Typography should support the concept and composition. Use one strong title, a concise supporting line, and only the amount of editorial information the poster actually needs. Place text mainly in quieter areas so it does not compete with the most complex collage regions.

The finished image should feel like a complete art or editorial poster, not a fan-shaped photo template. The shape itself should help tell the story.

Title: [Main English title]

Create a premium 9:16 editorial poster from the WORLD SLICE series.

Show a realistic natural landscape as if a section of the world has been physically cut open, revealing a much larger hidden structure beneath the visible surface.

Keep the surface relatively simple and easy to read, while the hidden section becomes the main visual surprise. Use strong scale contrast, clear geological or ecological layers, realistic materials, believable depth, atmospheric perspective and cinematic natural light.

The cutaway should not look like a glass box or aquarium. Treat it as a real piece of land, ocean, forest or ice physically sliced from the planet.

Let parts of nature break beyond the geometric cutaway boundary: roots, rock formations, ice, water or terrain may extend outside the original shape to create stronger visual impact.

Keep the central object around 55–70% of the poster width and preserve generous negative space. Avoid making the 3D cutaway too large.

Integrate typography into the composition instead of adding many tiny labels. Use one bold main title, one short supporting line and only a few minimal editorial details. Allow natural elements to overlap, pass behind or partially cover the typography.

Use a refined mix of modern serif and condensed sans-serif typography. The poster should feel like premium nature editorial design, contemporary art direction and photorealistic environmental visualization.

Prioritize:
strong thumbnail readability, one clear visual surprise, large recognizable forms, realistic natural textures, clean hierarchy, high-end editorial composition, and a strong contrast between the visible world and the hidden world.

No logo, no watermark, no numbering, no excessive micro text, no HUD interface, no four-point sparkle symbols, no cheap CGI, no glass-container look.

Make the final image feel like a complete finished poster, not a template.

提示词：

【古诗词】{填写诗词标题、作者及原文}
【海报主标题】{提取2–4个代表性汉字}
【核心意象】{如紫藤垂花、青绿飞檐、雨后海棠、罗扇流萤}
【画面场景】{如江南庭院、临水村落、古典园林}
【视觉关系】{如花蔓垂落、红绿映衬、花木包围建筑}
【主色调】{选择2–3种协调的东方传统色}
【画幅比例】9:16

根据古诗词创作一张具有教科书级插画质感的新中式细线设色艺术海报，将诗中的花木、建筑、人物与情绪转化为完整、精致的东方诗意场景。

【画风与质感】

采用现代东方装饰插画与传统工笔线描结合的绘画语言。树冠呈柔软蓬松的云团状完整色块，边缘具有细腻的粉末点染质感，内部穿插纤细、连续、自然分叉的墨黑枝条。

花木根据真实生长形态进行艺术化概括，紫藤保持自然垂挂，海棠花簇疏密有序，枝叶线条优雅流畅。以完整色面表现植物整体形态，不逐片描绘密集花瓣与树叶。

传统建筑采用精细规整的青绿色瓦片、优雅飞檐、暖白墙面与少量朱红木结构。整体平面化、设色饱满均匀，具有干净、哑光、细腻的纸本装饰质感。

【构图与空间】

采用高位俯瞰、东方散点透视与现代平面构成。

通过花木包围、枝条穿插、建筑遮挡、自然曲线与大面积暖米白留白组织画面，形成清晰的视觉重心和空间层次。

根据诗词灵活调整构图，突出最有代表性的景物与动作关系。建筑精描、植物概括、人物简练、背景留白。

避免反复使用固定的庭院布局，不强行添加无关的亭台、人物或装饰。地面和水面保持简洁，只用少量细线及不规则墨色阴影表现空间。

【东方配色】

采用石青、石绿、黛青、朱砂红、藤紫、粉赭、暖象牙白等东方传统色系。

以一种主色形成视觉重量，通过另一种对比色突出花木、建筑或人物主体，搭配墨色细线与暖白留白。

强调完整的大色面、协调的冷暖关系与清晰的明度层次。色彩浓郁而克制，均匀、哑光、不褪色，避免颜色杂乱、复杂渐变、厚重纹理与过度做旧。

【中文艺术海报排版】

在画面下方或侧边的深色树冠区域，融入大幅暖象牙白中文标题，采用厚重、端正、优雅的东方艺术字体，与花木色块形成自然叠压。

在适当留白处加入精致的小型纵排原诗句、准确的作者署名，以及一至两枚朱红印章。

文字清晰，层级分明，与景观自然融合，不添加虚构展览信息、编号或无意义装饰。

【最终质量】

保持完整的大色块构成、柔软云团树冠、纤细连续墨线、精致青绿建筑与优美留白。主体与辅助景物具有明确的细节层级，诗词意象符合自然规律。

避免写实摄影、3D、动漫、油画厚涂、浓重水墨、密集独立花叶、繁杂建筑、复杂地面、过度颗粒与人工做旧。

最终呈现一张画风统一、配色高级、诗意鲜明、具有成熟东方装饰美学的新中式古诗词艺术海报。

生成一张具有成熟 East Asian Editorial Design、Museum Poster 与文化出版物质感的竖版海报。

使用“非均衡三分构图”，让画面中的三个区域分别承担：

1. 主视觉对象
2. 巨型中文标题
3. 档案与辅助信息

不要平均切成三栏，也不要画明显分割线。

最重要的是，根据【物理关系】设计至少一处真实的跨区互动，让三个区域产生因果关系：

例如主体产生放大投影、镜面反射文字、印刷纸从版面揭起、拓片卷起露出原件等。

不要只是让元素彼此靠近，要让它们真正发生遮挡、穿插、反射、转印或前后揭示。

整体使用暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸，搭配墨黑 Typography 和一个主要主题色。中文采用现代高对比宋体 / 明朝体，英文标题使用 Serif，小型档案信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace。

主视觉必须具有明显大形，缩略图也能成立。巨型【中文核心字】要参与空间关系，可以被影子穿过、被镜面反射、出现在印刷结果中，或与真实物体形成前后层级。

加入与主题真正相关的【档案信息】，例如材料、尺寸、工艺步骤、结构剖面、表面样本或观察记录，让海报既有视觉冲击，也有内容深度。

信息密度保持中高，但至少保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，形成“主视觉高密、档案中密、纸面低密”的节奏。

最终阅读顺序：

第一眼看到强主视觉与巨大中文；第二眼发现跨区的物理关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或过程；第四眼阅读作品标题与档案信息。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级和编辑气质，但每张根据不同【物理关系】重新设计构图，不做模板换皮。

2. 巨型中文标题
3. 档案与辅助信息

不要平均切成三栏，也不要画明显分割线。

最重要的是，根据【物理关系】设计至少一处真实的跨区互动，让三个区域产生因果关系：

例如主体产生放大投影、镜面反射文字、印刷纸从版面揭起、拓片卷起露出原件等。

不要只是让元素彼此靠近，要让它们真正发生遮挡、穿插、反射、转印或前后揭示。

整体使用暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸，搭配墨黑 Typography 和一个主要主题色。中文采用现代高对比宋体 / 明朝体，英文标题使用 Serif，小型档案信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace。

主视觉必须具有明显大形，缩略图也能成立。巨型【中文核心字】要参与空间关系，可以被影子穿过、被镜面反射、出现在印刷结果中，或与真实物体形成前后层级。

加入与主题真正相关的【档案信息】，例如材料、尺寸、工艺步骤、结构剖面、表面样本或观察记录，让海报既有视觉冲击，也有内容深度。

信息密度保持中高，但至少保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，形成“主视觉高密、档案中密、纸面低密”的节奏。

最终阅读顺序：

第一眼看到强主视觉与巨大中文；第二眼发现跨区的物理关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或过程；第四眼阅读作品标题与档案信息。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级和编辑气质，但每张根据不同【物理关系】重新设计构图，不做模板换皮。

Prompt:

Create a 9:16 cinematic portrait poster built around atmosphere, light, reflection and emotional typography.

Start with a strong film-like portrait rather than a posed fashion photo. The subject should feel caught inside a real moment — looking through glass, standing in reflected city light, separated by shadow, or partially hidden by the environment. Keep natural skin texture, believable hair, expressive eyes and realistic lighting.

Use one main visual interference to shape the mood. This could be rain on glass, an incomplete reflection, a strong light leak, hard leaf shadows, a split moment between two portraits, soft bloom or controlled foreground blur. The effect should change how the portrait is perceived rather than simply decorate it.

Let part of the image remain clear while another part becomes hazy, reflected, overexposed or partially obscured. Controlled imperfection is important — the viewer should not see everything immediately.

Keep the color grading cinematic and distinctive. Cool blue, cyan, moss green, olive, steel grey or other restrained tones can dominate, while skin remains natural. Avoid muddy shadows and overly yellow or orange grading.

Typography should behave like part of the image. Mix an elegant serif or clean sans serif with one expressive handwritten phrase. Let text cross reflections, fade into light, overlap faces, extend beyond the frame or move across two photographic layers. Do not place every line neatly in empty space.

Keep supporting copy minimal — one strong title, one handwritten phrase and one short emotional sentence are enough.

The final image should feel somewhere between a film still, an art-house movie poster and a fashion editorial: atmospheric, intimate, visually layered and emotionally unresolved.

Avoid generic portrait layouts, excessive small text, rigid sidebars, fake movie credits, heavy UI graphics, random effects, image numbering, Vol./Issue labels, four-point sparkle symbols, logos and watermarks.

Create a 9:16 editorial poster based on a fan-shaped composition, with an emphasis on curved structures, flowing movement, and strong visual rhythm.

SUBJECT: [your subject]
TITLE: [main title]
CONCEPT: [core idea or mood]
FAN LOGIC: [flowing ribbon / offset arcs / radial burst / motion arcs / mixed curved fan structure]
VISUAL MATERIALS: [photography / collage / textures / painting / architecture / people / objects]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–4 main colors]
TYPOGRAPHY: [serif / grotesk / condensed sans / editorial mix]
BACKGROUND: [paper texture / flat tone / minimal backdrop]
TEXT DETAILS: [optional short meaningful phrases]

Use the fan-shaped composition as the main visual language, but do not limit it to straight wedges. The structure can bend, arc, curve, flow, expand, compress, or rotate depending on the concept.

Prioritize graceful visual movement. Let the composition guide the eye through the poster with ribbons, arcs, layered curved sections, or a single radial burst used in a more expressive way.

The shape should help express the idea:

* a flowing ribbon can suggest wind, motion, transition, or invisible force
* offset arcs can suggest observation, rhythm, memory, or layered perception
* a radial burst can suggest sound, signal, speed, or urban energy
* motion arcs can suggest body movement, choreography, or time unfolding

Build a strong large silhouette first, then fill it with controlled visual variety. Mix image sections, pure color areas, negative space, and small editorial details so the poster feels designed rather than template-based.

Allow some elements to break across the fan boundaries when useful. Curves should feel intentional and elegant, not decorative for their own sake.

Typography should feel integrated into the composition. Use one clear title, a short supporting line, and a small amount of editorial text. Keep the copy meaningful and concise.

The final poster should feel like an art-forward editorial collage: visually striking from a distance, but richer and more layered up close.

I love these posters. I have done a bunch but they never get old. GPT 2.5 prompt: 

4 images: 1:1, do this for 4 famous scientists: WITH topic_identity AS ( 
    SELECT
        derive_display_word('[TOPIC]') AS display_word,
        infer_primary_visual_form('[TOPIC]') AS hero_form,
        infer_semantic_motifs('[TOPIC]', 5, 15) AS motifs,
        infer_motion_logic('[TOPIC]') AS motion,
        infer_accent_palette('[TOPIC]') AS palette
),

layout_candidates AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        VALUES
            ('hero_right_type_left'),
            ('hero_left_type_right'),
            ('central_collision'),
            ('diagonal_motion'),
            ('radial_expansion'),
            ('vertical_ascent'),
            ('fragmented_field'),
            ('AI_invented_layout')
    ) AS L(layout)
),

ranked_layouts AS (
    SELECT
        layout,
        (
            0.28 * topic_fit(layout, '[TOPIC]') +
            0.22 * typography_readability(layout) +
            0.18 * hero_clarity(layout) +
            0.14 * motion_strength(layout) +
            0.10 * motif_capacity(layout) +
            0.08 * visual_surprise(layout)
        ) AS score
    FROM layout_candidates
)

SELECT render_poster(
    display_word => display_word,
    hero         => hero_form,
    motifs       => motifs,
    motion       => motion,
    palette      => palette,
    layout       => (
        SELECT layout
        FROM ranked_layouts
        ORDER BY score DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ),
    style        => 'kinetic editorial print collage'
)
FROM topic_identity;

Prompt：

【主题 / 作品名】：____
【左侧内容】：____
【右侧内容】：____
【左右关系】：整体与局部 / 原始与结果 / 瞬间与延展 / 密集与留白 / 其他
【跨区连接方式】：主体越界 / 材质转译 / 色彩延展 / 云雾过渡 / 动作轨迹 / 其他
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【主色调】：____
【辅助色】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 Editorial Graphic Design 与展览视觉质感的左右构图海报。

核心不是把画面机械地平均分成左右两半，而是建立两个功能不同、视觉重量不同，但彼此存在明确关系的视觉区域。

左右比例不要固定 50:50，可根据内容采用 35:65、40:60、45:55、60:40 等不等比例关系，通过主体大小、色彩深浅、信息密度和留白完成视觉配重。

左、右两侧应承担不同视觉任务，例如：一侧展示完整主体，另一侧放大局部纹理；一侧呈现原始材料，另一侧展示其转化后的视觉结果；一侧定格人物或物体，另一侧延展动作、轨迹或能量；一侧保持高密度图像，另一侧用大面积留白和 Typography 完成平衡。

最重要的是“中间边界”。不要使用生硬竖线直接分栏，而要让至少一种核心元素跨越左右区域，使两侧真正连接起来：

主体局部自然越界；材质由实体逐渐变成平面图像；颜色、墨迹或纹理跨区延展；动作轨迹从主体一侧延伸到另一侧；云雾、光影或空间结构在边界处自然消散。让中轴成为“关系发生的位置”，而不是简单的分隔线。

Typography 根据作品内容组织。主标题、作品短句和辅助信息都必须与主题本身有关，不使用“左右构图”“设计案例”“视觉研究”等模板化占位文字。

文字可以参与左右配重：图像较重的一侧减少文字，留白较多的一侧增加标题或信息；也可以让标题跨越边界，与主体产生穿插。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要色系。左右可以存在明显冷暖、明暗或材质反差，但需要有至少一种颜色、纹理或文字系统作为视觉连接，避免看起来像两张图片硬拼在一起。

保留足够呼吸空间，通过：不等比例、视觉配重、主体越界、材质转译、疏密变化、Typography 穿插建立有设计感的左右关系。

最终阅读顺序应清晰：第一眼感受到左右两侧的视觉反差；第二眼发现中轴处的连接或变化；第三眼理解两个区域之间的内容关系；最后阅读标题与作品信息。

整体要求：左右关系明确但不生硬，两个区域各有作用又属于同一件作品，有视觉层次、有内容逻辑、有成熟 Editorial Poster 质感。

Prompt:

FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where the main word is revealed through spatial alignment rather than simply printed onto the scene.

The title should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition and become readable only when the physical structure, viewpoint and visual conditions align correctly.

For specular typography, use separate reflective surfaces whose highlights visually connect into the word from one precise viewpoint.

For a vector field, use the direction, density and depth of repeated elements to make the typography emerge from their spatial orientation.

For layered sections, split the word across multiple separated horizontal planes so the slices visually reconnect into one complete title only from the correct viewing height.

For counter-tilt typography, distribute the letterforms across physically sloped surfaces while making the complete word appear visually level from the intended camera position.

Keep perspective, depth, lighting, occlusion and material behavior physically believable. From another angle or viewing height, the word should begin to break apart and reveal the real spatial system behind it.

Use bold geometric sans-serif typography, a restrained architectural environment and a controlled high-contrast palette. Keep the composition clean and strong enough to read at thumbnail size.

If a person is included, keep them relatively small and use them mainly as a scale reference or observer interacting naturally with the installation.

Add only minimal editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, anamorphic installation, spatial graphic design, contemporary architecture, editorial poster, clean hierarchy and strong visual impact.

提示词：

【古诗词】{填写诗词标题、作者及原文}
【海报主标题】{提取2–4个代表性汉字}
【核心意象】{如飞鹤、垂柳、林间夕照、梅枝疏影}
【视觉动势】{如斜向飞升、曲线垂坠、光影穿插、枝影交错}
【画面场景】{填写或由AI根据诗词提取}
【主色调】{选择2–3种协调的东方传统色}
【画幅比例】9:16

根据古诗词创作一张具有教科书级插画质感的新中式细线设色艺术海报，将诗中的自然景物、动态关系与光影意境转化为完整、优美的东方视觉作品。

【画风与质感】

采用现代东方装饰插画与传统工笔线描相结合的绘画语言。树冠呈柔软蓬松的云团状完整色块，边缘具有细腻的粉末点染质感，内部穿插纤细、连续、自然分叉的墨黑枝条。

飞鸟、垂柳、梅枝等主体保留各自真实合理的形态，使用完整的平面设色与少量精细长线表现结构。建筑如有出现，采用规整青绿瓦片、优雅飞檐与简洁墙面。整体色彩饱满均匀、哑光干净，保留轻微纸本质感。

【构图与视觉动势】

采用高位俯瞰、东方散点透视与现代平面构成，根据诗意灵活调整视角。

重点提取诗词中的方向、曲线与空间关系，例如白鹤展翅向上、柳枝随风垂落、夕照斜入密林、梅枝横斜与水中疏影呼应。

通过大面积色块、斜向引导、自然曲线和暖米白留白形成明确的视觉焦点。动势自然流畅，主体突出，辅助景物概括，避免元素堆砌和复杂背景。

【东方配色与光影】

使用石青、石绿、黛青、朱砂红、赭金、暖象牙白等东方传统色系。

以一种主色建立视觉重量，另一种对比色突出核心意象。强调冷暖关系、明度层次与完整的大色面，保留干净的留白。

阳光、树影与水中倒影使用克制的平面设色和少量细线表达，避免摄影式体积光、复杂反射、强烈渐变和厚重阴影。

【中文海报排版】

在画面下方或侧边深色区域融入大幅暖象牙白中文标题，采用厚重、端正、优雅的东方艺术字体。

在适当留白处加入精致的小型纵排原诗句、准确的朝代与作者署名，以及一至两枚朱红印章。文字清晰，疏密有序，与画面动势自然协调。

【最终质量】

保持大形鲜明、长线流畅、色彩完整、局部精描与背景留白的视觉层级。

避免写实摄影、3D、动漫、油画厚涂、浓重水墨、密集独立叶片、复杂羽毛、杂乱纹理、过度颗粒与人工做旧。

最终呈现一张画风统一、构图有张力、色彩高级、诗意鲜明的新中式古诗词艺术海报。远看具有强烈的视觉识别度，近看拥有精致细腻的工笔线条与东方装饰美感。

A new prompt I worked on for GPT 2.5. It's for visualizing supply chains. 

16:9, 2x2 grid, do this for coffee, diamond, gold, and another topic WITH topic_structure AS (
    SELECT
        infer_best_process_model('[TOPIC]') AS process_model,
        infer_process_stages('[TOPIC]', 3, 5) AS stages
),

connector AS (
    SELECT
        infer_continuity_element(
            '[TOPIC]',
            topic_structure.stages
        ) AS flow_element
),

stage_worlds AS (
    SELECT
        stage,
        infer_environment(stage) AS environment,
        infer_hero_object(stage) AS hero,
        infer_actors(stage) AS actors,
        infer_actions(stage) AS actions,
        infer_props(stage) AS props
    FROM UNNEST(topic_structure.stages) AS stage
)

SELECT render_scene
FROM latent_miniature_diorama_archive
WHERE composition = 'single_connected_tabletop_world'
AND stage_count BETWEEN 3 AND 5
AND worlds = stage_worlds
AND connector = connector.flow_element
AND camera = 'elevated_macro_three_quarter'
AND style = 'handcrafted_collectible_process_diorama'
ORDER BY
    process_clarity DESC,
    connector_strength DESC,
    miniature_storytelling DESC,
    material_coherence DESC
LIMIT 1;

10、信息图：左MOSS-Image、右GPT Image 2

提示词：
一张极简艺术风格的[芦笋]百科全书式信息卡片，
博物馆展品级别的设计品质，信息丰富但视觉克制

【整体构图 - 黄金分割布局】
- 画面比例：2:3竖版 或 3:4方形
- 三大视觉区域：
* 顶部展示区（30%）：大尺寸食材摄影 + 优雅标题排版
* 中部信息区（60%）：多层次信息模块网格系统
* 底部注释区（10%）：来源标注 + 设计细节

【顶部展示区 - 视觉焦点】
• 食材名称：超大字号，细线体/宋体，字间距加宽
• 拉丁学名：小字号斜体，灰色调
• 食材分类标签：极简胶囊形状标签
• 主图：去背景食材特写，工作室灯光，微阴影
• 原产地小型地图图示
• 当季时间轴线条图

【中部核心信息区 - 9大模块】

1、营养成分详解
- 圆环图：卡路里、蛋白质、碳水、脂肪占比
- 条形图：维生素A/C/E/K含量对比
- 矿物质微量元素列表（钙、铁、锌等）
- 每100g营养数据精确标注
- GI值（升糖指数）可视化刻度尺

2、健康功效地图
- 人体轮廓图标注受益部位
- 5-6个主要功效图标化展示
- 功效强度等级标识（⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐）
- 科学研究来源小标注

3、烹饪方法矩阵
- 8-10种烹饪方式图标网格
- 每种方式最佳温度/时间参数
- 营养保留率百分比显示
- 推荐指数星级评价
- 难度等级色彩标识

4、四季食用指南
- 圆形时间轮盘设计
- 标注最佳食用月份
- 不同季节功效变化说明
- 时令搭配建议

5、黄金搭配矩阵
- 9宫格搭配食材小图标
- 搭配理由简短标注
- 协同增效/相克警示
- 经典菜品配方示例
- 营养互补关系连线图

6、适宜人群画像
- 人群图标（儿童/孕妇/老人/运动员等）
- 推荐程度色彩编码
- 特殊人群剂量建议
- 年龄段分类指南

7、禁忌与注意事项
- 红色警示框设计
- 不宜人群清晰列举
- 过敏源标识
- 药物相互作用提示
- 最大摄入量警戒线

8、选购与储存指南
- 新鲜度判断要点（颜色/手感/气味）
- 品质等级划分图示
- 最佳储存温度/湿度数据
- 保鲜期时间轴
- 冷藏/冷冻/常温图标指南

9、趣味知识扩展
- 历史小故事（起源/传说）
- 世界各地别名
- 年产量数据可视化
- 有机/转基因标识说明
- 可持续性评级

【视觉系统 - 极简艺术美学】

配色方案：
- 主色：食材本身的自然色彩提取
- 辅色：大地色系（米白/燕麦/亚麻/石墨灰）
- 强调色：克制使用1-2个高纯度色彩
- 背景：纯白或极浅灰（#FAFAFA）
- 文字：深灰而非纯黑（#2C2C2C）

字体系统：
- 标题：超细线条无衬线字体（Helvetica Neue UltraLight）
- 正文：现代几何字体（DIN/Futura）
- 数据：等宽字体（Roboto Mono）
- 中文：思源黑体Light/方正兰亭黑
- 字号层级：6级字号系统（48/32/24/16/12/10pt）

图标系统：
- 统一2pt线宽
- 圆角一致性（2px）
- 24x24px网格对齐
- stroke而非fill优先
- 负空间利用

布局系统：
- 12列网格系统
- 8pt基准网格对齐
- 模块间距：24pt/32pt/48pt
- 边距：页边距48pt起
- 卡片圆角：8-12px
- 微妙分割线：0.5pt，15%透明度

质感细节：
- 微渐变背景（3-5%色值变化）
- 柔和投影（0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)）
- 磨砂玻璃效果（backdrop-filter: blur(20px)）
- 元素间微妙高度差异（海拔系统）
- 数据区域淡色填充（5%透明度）

【信息可视化原则】
- 数据图表：Edward Tufte简约数据墨水原则
- 去除非必要装饰
- 图表网格线极淡（10%透明度）
- 数据点精确标注
- 趋势线平滑自然

【呼吸感营造】
- 模块间留白≥模块内容宽度的25%
- 文字行间距1.6-1.8倍
- 段落间距≥2行高
- 图文组合留白法则

风格关键词：
瑞士国际主义平面设计、日本侘寂美学、包豪斯功能主义、
斯堪的纳维亚极简主义、Dieter Rams设计哲学、
无印良品视觉语言、Kinfolk杂志美学、
苹果产品设计语言、Google Material Design精髓

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a 9:16 editorial collage poster built around a fan-shaped composition where the geometry directly expresses the concept.

SUBJECT: [your theme / subject]
TITLE: [main title]
CONCEPT: [what the poster should communicate]
FAN STRUCTURE: [layered curved fan / concentric arcs / large color wedges / radial burst / custom variation]
VISUAL CONTENT: [people / places / events / objects / moments / textures]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–5 dominant colors]
TYPOGRAPHY: [editorial serif / grotesk / condensed sans / mixed system]
BACKGROUND: [paper tone / flat color / minimal backdrop]
TEXT DETAILS: [short meaningful phrases / optional event or editorial information]

Choose the fan structure according to the meaning of the poster rather than using it as decoration.

For example:

* layered curved fans can suggest distance, travel, space, or unfolding experience
* concentric arcs can suggest emotion, perception, memory, or inner states
* large color wedges can organize communities, events, contrasting themes, or parallel worlds
* sharp radial cuts can suggest time, speed, simultaneous moments, or explosive energy

Build one clear large-scale composition first. From a distance, the fan geometry should be immediately readable and visually striking; up close, the viewer should discover richer photography, people, environments, textures, and narrative details.

Do not make every section equal. Vary the width, scale, density, and direction of the fan areas. Mix image-heavy sections with pure color fields and negative space to create rhythm.

Photography should adapt to the geometry rather than sit inside rectangular frames. Use bold cropping, scale shifts, partial subjects, layered imagery, and a few controlled elements crossing the boundaries when useful.

Keep each major section visually coherent with its own dominant color or tonal identity. The overall palette should feel intentional, not randomly multicolored.

Typography should support the concept and composition. Use one strong title, a concise supporting line, and only the amount of editorial information the poster actually needs. Place text mainly in quieter areas so it does not compete with the most complex collage regions.

The finished image should feel like a complete art or editorial poster, not a fan-shaped photo template. The shape itself should help tell the story.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：
【中文标题】：
【英文标题】：
【核心主体】：
【三栏关系】：图像越栏 / 主体偏置 / 现象跨栏 / 近中远空间 / 其他
【左栏内容】：
【中栏内容】：
【右栏内容】：
【跨栏元素】：花枝 / 主体轮廓 / 声场线 / 建筑线 / 水路 / 其他
【主色调】：
【日期 / 场馆】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用「竖三栏 / 左中右构图」。

重点不是把三个内容分别塞进三个栏，而是先用不等宽三栏建立清晰秩序，再通过主体、图像、线条、空间或无形视觉元素突破栏线，让三个区域重新形成一个完整画面。

可根据主题灵活使用以下方式：

图像越栏：传统绘画、花枝、鸟羽、植物或其他图像主体主要位于一至两个栏位，但局部必须主动突破边界，与其他色栏和 Typography 产生穿插关系。

主体偏置：大型文物、雕塑或人物明显压在其中一侧，另一侧通过年代、材质、档案文字和研究图建立视觉重量。主体可以侵入相邻栏位，但不要机械居中。

现象跨栏：实体主体停留在一侧，让声音、光线、烟气、水纹、运动轨迹等无形元素成为真正连接三栏的视觉线索。线条需要有明确来源、方向和传播逻辑，不要变成科技 UI 或随机装饰。

近中远空间：让三个栏分别承担近景、中景和远景，通过枝条、墙线、水路、石径、建筑轴线或视线连续跨栏，使三个区域看起来属于同一个空间，而不是三张照片拼贴。

三栏比例不要平均，根据主题使用例如 24/30/46、28/22/50、38/34/28 等不同关系。每一栏可以拥有不同背景色、信息密度和视觉重量，但整体必须平衡。

Typography 根据画面内容重新设计。可以使用横向跨栏标题、中等尺度标题、局部反色、图像压字、文字被主体轻微遮挡等方式。不要每张都使用超大单字，也不要固定使用四字纵排或“两字横排 + 两字竖排”。

信息密度参考成熟博物馆海报、艺术图录和 Editorial Design。可加入英文副标题、材质、年代、结构、日期、场馆、策展短句以及少量研究内容。

研究信息应与主题直接相关，例如：

文物测绘、纹样放大、材质档案、声学传播、近中远关系、建筑剖面或空间视线。

面积保持克制，作为第二层阅读内容，不要抢主视觉，也不要做成百科或 PPT。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色。优先使用大面积纯净色域，例如骨白、赭红、朱砂、深青蓝、墨绿、青铜绿等。主体颜色、栏位颜色与 Typography 之间必须形成清楚层级。

核心原则：三栏负责建立秩序，跨栏元素负责打破边界，主体负责视觉重量，信息负责完成作品内容。

整体要求：9:16，高清、清晰、色块干净、主体完整、文字与细线锐利、信息丰富但有秩序，具有真正成熟的文化展览海报与艺术图录完成度。

避免：机械三等分、三个独立卡片、三张图片拼贴感、主体全部困在栏内、固定标题模板、PPT 信息框、科技 HUD、随机跨栏线、无意义小字、过度做旧、斑驳噪点、复杂 UI 和低完成度 AI 海报感。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

【Theme】
【Main visual information】
【Concept】
【Accent color】
【Key visual phenomenon】

Create a 9:16 vertical experimental editorial architecture poster based on the theme above.

Transform the central concept into a monumental surreal architectural space rather than simply placing text on a building. Typography, architecture, light, human figures and the key visual phenomenon should belong to the same physical world.

Design one immediately recognizable visual hook using the main visual information. Large numbers or words should be physically integrated into walls, slabs, frames, platforms or other architectural surfaces, affected naturally by scale, cropping, perspective, depth and occlusion. Avoid flat poster text placed over the image.

Create an impossible but visually coherent architectural composition with strong depth, oversized geometric structures, generous negative space and clear hierarchy. Do not rely on conventional skyscrapers or repetitive building blocks. Let the architectural language respond directly to the theme. Cinema may become frames and projection space, weather may become fins, clouds and rain, memory may become rooms or archives, and absence may become empty display structures and shadows.

Include approximately 6 to 12 tiny adult human figures throughout the scene. Keep them realistic in scale and understated in pose. Use them to communicate monumentality, distance, loneliness and human presence rather than making them the main subject.

Use one distinctive physical or atmospheric event as the secondary hook, such as a wide projection beam, suspended rain curtain, impossible cast shadow, floating architectural page, cloud layer, unusual reflection or dramatic geometric sunlight. This phenomenon should interact with the architecture rather than appear as a decorative effect.

Keep the palette highly restrained: warm ivory white, pale concrete gray, graphite black and soft desaturated sky tones, plus only one muted accent color occupying a small percentage of the image. Avoid colorful commercial architecture.

Use refined high contrast serif typography with a limited amount of thin sans serif technical text. Add a small set of meaningful words, data or short phrases related to the theme, but keep many architectural surfaces completely blank. The image should feel designed, not filled.

Use matte stone, concrete, paper like grain, subtle graphite texture and delicate scan noise. Avoid glossy CGI rendering. The final surface should resemble a sophisticated architecture publication, cultural poster, museum editorial or experimental printed artwork.

Use believable natural light, strong spatial shadows and atmospheric depth. Maintain a clear relationship between foreground, middle ground and distant structures.

The final image should feel monumental, intelligent, surreal, quiet and visually striking even at small social media thumbnail size. Prioritize one strong visual idea over excessive complexity.

【中部垂直元素】：填写半透明纸、薄纱、雨幕、植物影、手部动作残影等

【主题短句】：填写一句关于时间、材料、记忆或人的短句
【主色调】：填写低饱和自然色，默认暖象牙米白、灰褐、浅赭、灰绿、墨褐
【画幅比例】：9:16

生成一张当代东方人文艺术展览海报，整体融合东方自然美学、材料档案、独立艺术杂志与现代 Editorial Design。画面安静、克制、优雅，有明显纸本感和人文气质，不做传统国潮，也不做商业广告海报。

严格保持固定版式结构：画面右下角放置一个被明显放大的【右下主视觉】，约占画面 50%–60%，主体必须被右侧或底部自然裁切，形成强烈的大尺度视觉锚点；画面中间偏左加入一条从顶部垂下的【中部垂直元素】，约占画面宽度 20%–25%，保持半透明、低对比和材料感，内部可以隐约出现植物、手影、纹理、文字残痕或自然痕迹，但不能抢过主视觉。

画面左侧保留大面积暖米白留白，纵向排列【中文标题】，使用纤细、修长、具有东方骨架的现代宋体或高级中文 Serif，不使用巨大毛笔书法。中文标题下方加入【英文标题】，使用优雅纤细的英文 Serif Typography，并加入少量主题短句和极小型编辑信息。

左上、右上、左下形成固定的小型信息系统：左上放系列身份或展览类别；右上放一个非常小的【右上档案物】以及 2–3 个极小英文关键词；左下放日期、场馆或展览说明。小字只承担编辑纹理，不要塞满画面，不生成大量无意义英文。

背景使用干净温润的象牙米白高级艺术纸，只保留轻微天然纸纤维、细颗粒和 Offset Print 印刷质感。整体配色采用【主色调】，低饱和、柔和、哑光，不使用纯黑纯白、高饱和渐变或商业亮色。

真实材料必须保留清楚的触感，例如木纹、纸纤维、陶土旋纹、水纹、植物叶脉、布料纹理或石头表面，但不要过度锐化、HDR 或 CGI。画面远看依靠“左侧标题 + 中部垂直结构 + 右下巨大主视觉”成立，近看才逐渐发现材料细节、小型档案物和微型文字。

最终效果应像真正存在于当代艺术馆、文化机构或独立艺术出版物中的东方人文展览海报，让每张作品都有明确主题和意义，而不是模板化占位设计。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a 9:16 editorial collage poster built around a fan-shaped composition where the geometry directly expresses the concept.

SUBJECT: [your theme / subject]
TITLE: [main title]
CONCEPT: [what the poster should communicate]
FAN STRUCTURE: [layered curved fan / concentric arcs / large color wedges / radial burst / custom variation]
VISUAL CONTENT: [people / places / events / objects / moments / textures]
COLOR SYSTEM: [2–5 dominant colors]
TYPOGRAPHY: [editorial serif / grotesk / condensed sans / mixed system]
BACKGROUND: [paper tone / flat color / minimal backdrop]
TEXT DETAILS: [short meaningful phrases / optional event or editorial information]

Choose the fan structure according to the meaning of the poster rather than using it as decoration.

For example:

* layered curved fans can suggest distance, travel, space, or unfolding experience
* concentric arcs can suggest emotion, perception, memory, or inner states
* large color wedges can organize communities, events, contrasting themes, or parallel worlds
* sharp radial cuts can suggest time, speed, simultaneous moments, or explosive energy

Build one clear large-scale composition first. From a distance, the fan geometry should be immediately readable and visually striking; up close, the viewer should discover richer photography, people, environments, textures, and narrative details.

Do not make every section equal. Vary the width, scale, density, and direction of the fan areas. Mix image-heavy sections with pure color fields and negative space to create rhythm.

Photography should adapt to the geometry rather than sit inside rectangular frames. Use bold cropping, scale shifts, partial subjects, layered imagery, and a few controlled elements crossing the boundaries when useful.

Keep each major section visually coherent with its own dominant color or tonal identity. The overall palette should feel intentional, not randomly multicolored.

Typography should support the concept and composition. Use one strong title, a concise supporting line, and only the amount of editorial information the poster actually needs. Place text mainly in quieter areas so it does not compete with the most complex collage regions.

The finished image should feel like a complete art or editorial poster, not a fan-shaped photo template. The shape itself should help tell the story.

WORD = semantic_compress(
    INPUT,
    objective="short + visually distinctive + immediately related"
)

DNA = infer({
    "structures",
    "machines",
    "agents",
    "terrain",
    "symbols",
    "actions",
    "forces"
}, from_=INPUT)

def inspect(glyph):
    return {
        "stems": extract_stems(glyph),
        "bars": extract_crossbars(glyph),
        "curves": extract_curves(glyph),
        "diagonals": extract_diagonals(glyph),
        "counters": extract_negative_spaces(glyph),
        "terminals": extract_terminals(glyph)
    }

def reinterpret(part, DNA):
    candidates = find_topic_forms_with_matching_geometry(part, DNA)

    return argmax(
        candidates,
        key=lambda x:
            shape_similarity(part, x)
            * semantic_relevance(x, INPUT)
            * functional_plausibility(x)
    )

WORLD = {}

for glyph in WORD:
    geometry = inspect(glyph)

    WORLD[glyph] = {
        part: reinterpret(shape, DNA)
        for part, shape in geometry.items()
    }

ACTION = infer_most_visual_action(INPUT)

ACTION_PATH = solve_trajectory(
    action=ACTION,
    start=find_best_glyph_origin(WORLD),
    end=find_best_glyph_destination(WORLD),
    requirement="path should unify multiple letters compositionally"
)

add(
    micro_agents=infer_scale_figures(INPUT),
    environmental_baseline=infer_shared_ground_or_context(INPUT),
    action_path=ACTION_PATH
)

render(
    WORD,
    WORLD,
    medium="expressive monochrome brush ink",
    composition="wide typographic panorama",
    whitespace="very high",
    priority=[
        "word readability",
        "functional transformation",
        "action storytelling",
        "microdetail"

Prompt：

【主题 / 作品名】：____
【核心内容】：____
【散点类型】：同类元素 / 实体物件 / 数字信息 / 碎片结构 / 图像与文字混合
【第一视觉锚点】：____
【辅助散点】：____
【主色调】：____
【强调色】：____
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有高信息密度、成熟 Editorial Graphic Design 与文化展览气质的散点构图海报。核心不是把元素随机撒满画面，而是建立多个大小、方向、密度不同的视觉锚点，再通过颜色、字体、间距、重复关系和隐形网格，把它们组织成一个完整作品。

整张画面设置约 4–7 个主要视觉锚点，并允许加入更多微型信息颗粒。必须保持明确主次：第一视觉锚点承担约 30%–40% 的视觉重量，第二、第三锚点明显次一级，其他元素作为小型散点穿插。通过至少 3 个尺度层级制造节奏：超大标题 / 主体 → 中型图像或物件 → 极小文字、数字、标签和细节，不要让所有元素尺寸接近。

根据内容选择合适的散点方式：同类元素可通过大小、方向、距离和局部裁切形成节奏，不做规则网格；实体物件利用不同轮廓、材质和视觉重量错落排列；数字、时间、坐标和数据可打散到不同区域，用字号与颜色建立跳读路径；碎片结构可围绕一个隐形整体排列，通过负空间、局部轮廓或纹样连续关系，让观众主动补全完整形态。

画面信息可以丰富，但不要平均分布。建议形成 2–3 个高密度区域、1 个中等密度区域，并保留至少 20%–30% 的安静空间。建立 3–4 条隐形纵向或横向基线，让标题、图片边缘、数字和标签在视觉上暗中对齐；允许主动打破网格，但必须先有网格逻辑。加入约 3–4 处有控制的穿插关系，例如文字局部被主体遮挡、图片压住标题边缘、标签与物件轻微叠压、色块或线条跨过不同信息区域。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要色系，不要平均使用颜色。确定一个主结构色，再让同一种强调色分散出现在不同区域，通过远距离颜色呼应把视觉散点重新连接起来。Typography 需要有明确层级：大型中文标题承担主要视觉重量，英文标题建立第二层结构，数字和日期可成为独立视觉锚点，正文与标签保持较小字号；允许横排、纵排、局部旋转和裁切，但不要随机旋转所有文字。

所有文字必须属于作品本身，例如时间、地点、材质、观察记录、作品短句、对象名称或相关数据，不出现“散点构图”“设计案例”“Visual Study”“Composition”“Series 01”等模板占位文字。最终第一眼应看到 1–2 个强视觉锚点，第二眼开始在不同散点之间跳跃，第三眼发现颜色、尺寸、方向和信息之间的呼应；放大后仍然有第二层、第三层细节可以阅读。

整体要求：高信息密度、杂而不乱、多锚点但主次明确、丰富、有节奏、有作品感，像成熟的艺术展览海报、独立出版物或 Editorial Poster。避免规则九宫格、平均撒元素、所有内容一样大、每个区域都塞满、PPT 信息块、无意义英文、过多边框、随机贴纸拼贴和主次不分。

Prompt:

【Theme】
【Main visual information】
【Concept】
【Accent color】
【Key visual phenomenon】

Create a 9:16 vertical experimental editorial architecture poster based on the theme above.

Transform the central concept into a monumental surreal architectural space rather than simply placing text on a building. Typography, architecture, light, human figures and the key visual phenomenon should belong to the same physical world.

Design one immediately recognizable visual hook using the main visual information. Large numbers or words should be physically integrated into walls, slabs, frames, platforms or other architectural surfaces, affected naturally by scale, cropping, perspective, depth and occlusion. Avoid flat poster text placed over the image.

Create an impossible but visually coherent architectural composition with strong depth, oversized geometric structures, generous negative space and clear hierarchy. Do not rely on conventional skyscrapers or repetitive building blocks. Let the architectural language respond directly to the theme. Cinema may become frames and projection space, weather may become fins, clouds and rain, memory may become rooms or archives, and absence may become empty display structures and shadows.

Include approximately 6 to 12 tiny adult human figures throughout the scene. Keep them realistic in scale and understated in pose. Use them to communicate monumentality, distance, loneliness and human presence rather than making them the main subject.

Use one distinctive physical or atmospheric event as the secondary hook, such as a wide projection beam, suspended rain curtain, impossible cast shadow, floating architectural page, cloud layer, unusual reflection or dramatic geometric sunlight. This phenomenon should interact with the architecture rather than appear as a decorative effect.

Keep the palette highly restrained: warm ivory white, pale concrete gray, graphite black and soft desaturated sky tones, plus only one muted accent color occupying a small percentage of the image. Avoid colorful commercial architecture.

Use refined high contrast serif typography with a limited amount of thin sans serif technical text. Add a small set of meaningful words, data or short phrases related to the theme, but keep many architectural surfaces completely blank. The image should feel designed, not filled.

Use matte stone, concrete, paper like grain, subtle graphite texture and delicate scan noise. Avoid glossy CGI rendering. The final surface should resemble a sophisticated architecture publication, cultural poster, museum editorial or experimental printed artwork.

Use believable natural light, strong spatial shadows and atmospheric depth. Maintain a clear relationship between foreground, middle ground and distant structures.

The final image should feel monumental, intelligent, surreal, quiet and visually striking even at small social media thumbnail size. Prioritize one strong visual idea over excessive complexity.

不要只是给人物加特效，而要表现这种无形现象如何真正改变周围空间：

热，可以通过空气折射、边缘轻微错位与背景弯曲，让空间产生波动；

雾，可以通过连续、柔和、半透明的层次逐渐抹去人物与环境边界；

尘，可以借助光束显现空气中原本不可见的细小颗粒，并产生自然悬浮与漂移；

磁，可以通过连续线条的弯曲、疏密变化与微粒排列，让看不见的力场显现方向。

人物必须真正处在这种空间变化之中，前景、人物、中景和背景要产生明确关系，不要变成“人物 + 背景特效”的简单叠加。

整体延续 Contemporary Asian Editorial Design / Museum Poster 气质：

暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸背景，细腻纸张纹理与轻微哑光印刷颗粒；真实自然的人物摄影质感；现代高对比中文 Typography + 优雅 Serif 英文标题 + 少量 Grotesk / Monospace 微信息；低饱和主题色，并用极少朱砂红作为系列视觉节点。

版面保持中高信息密度，同时保留约 20%–25% 有效留白。标题、人物与空间变化形成清楚的视觉层级。

所有辅助文字都围绕当前主题，可加入方向、距离、温度、光线、空气、边界等少量观察信息，不使用 Series No.、Visual Study、Composition 等模板化文字。

重点保证：

空气折射自然，不做夸张液化变形；
雾气连续、柔和、通透，不出现块状灰斑和脏污；
微尘细小、稀疏，只在光中被看见，不做闪粉或满屏颗粒；
磁力线连续顺滑，不做科技 HUD、霓虹能量线或科幻 UI；
人物皮肤真实自然，不过度磨皮、发光或油亮。

最终让观众第一眼看到完整人物海报，第二眼发现：真正组织画面的不是装饰，而是这些看不见的现象正在改变空间、边界与方向。

使用纯白或轻微冷调的高级手工艺术纸作为背景，保留真实纸纤维、纸浆颗粒和自然压痕。保持约 65%–75% 的有效留白，主体不要过大，【小主体】建议只占画面约 8%–20%，让空白本身参与表达距离、等待、记忆与未完成感。

不要直接复刻诗句中的完整场景，而是选择一个小而明确的物件作为情绪锚点，再通过颜色变化、消失、堆积、残影或运动路径表现情绪状态。

【主题 / 作品名】：____

【中轴变化】：____ → ____ → ____
【中文标题】：____

【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 Editorial Design 与展览视觉质感的左右构图海报。

不要简单把画面切成左右两栏，而是让左右两个视觉区域表达同一个主题的不同状态，并让“中间边界”成为变化真正发生的位置。

左右区域采用不等比例布局，根据主体重量使用 40:60、45:55、55:45 等关系，不要机械 50:50。左侧负责建立起点或原始状态，右侧负责展示变化后的结果，例如：
正面作品 → 背后的结构与制作路径；
设计草图 → 建成后的真实空间；
声源主体 → 向外扩散的振动与声场；
真实实体 → 纸面上的拓印、痕迹或图像。

最重要的是中轴转译。不要用明显竖线分隔，而要选择一个核心元素穿过左右区域，并在跨越中轴时连续发生变化.

例如：花瓣逐渐化成针脚和丝线；建筑线稿逐渐变成真实墙面；器物震动逐渐扩散成声纹；石刻浮雕逐渐压平成为黑墨拓印。

这种变化必须连续、自然，让观众一眼理解左右两边存在因果、过程或转译关系，而不是两张无关图片拼在一起。

Typography 也参与左右关系，但所有文字必须属于作品本身。使用真正的作品标题、副标题、短句和展览信息，不出现“左右构图”“设计案例”“视觉研究”等模板占位文字。

图像较重的一侧减少信息，较空的一侧可以承担更多标题与文字，通过字体大小、密度和位置完成视觉配重。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要色系。左右可以有明显明暗、冷暖或材质差异，但至少保留一种颜色、纹理或视觉元素跨越中轴，保证整张作品统一。

最终阅读顺序：第一眼看到左右两种明显不同的视觉状态；第二眼发现中轴处正在发生连接和变化；第三眼理解“左边为什么会变成右边”；最后再阅读标题与作品信息。

整体要求：两个视觉域各有作用，中间有明确转译过程，左右不平均但视觉平衡，既有内容逻辑，也有成熟作品感。

MONUMENTAL_TRANSFORMATION:

Choose an appropriate treatment:

- transportation
- small events

- landscapes

- historical artifacts
- miniature signs
- relevant technologies
- narrative environments

Use strong scale contrast.

The central object should feel enormous
compared with the miniature inhabitants.

CHARACTER_TRANSLATION:

Where the subject benefits from personality,

CHARACTER_STYLE = {

}

Do not apply cute facial features

Allow the monumental central object

INK_WORLD:

- hand-drawn miniature people

ACCENTS = infer_palette($ SUBJECT)

LAYOUT_SELECTOR:

Combine realistic material detail,

Prompt:

Theme = [friends / creative team / film characters / musicians / athletes / brand community]
People = [5–8 adults, describe their identities and mood]
Layout = [orbit / mosaic / portrait grid / narrative slices]
Headline = [TITLE]
Palette = [2–3 main colors]
Ratio = 9:16

Create a bold multi-person editorial poster where the people themselves become the composition.

Use different portrait scales instead of giving everyone equal space. Choose one clear visual hierarchy with one or two dominant subjects, several supporting portraits, and a few cropped details. Let faces, shoulders, hands or hair break outside their image areas so the layout feels alive rather than like a clean photo grid.

Build the poster around one strong organizing idea. The people can follow an irregular curve, sit inside different-sized photo blocks, be divided into angled narrative slices, or appear through oversized typography. Keep the structure intentional but slightly unpredictable.

Mix portrait photography with a few different visual treatments when useful — close-ups, side profiles, hard light, soft shadow, slight motion blur or one intentionally out-of-focus image. Don’t apply every effect at once.

Typography should connect the whole group. Use one strong headline with real meaning, make it large enough to cross several portraits, and allow people to cover parts of the letters or appear through their negative space.

Keep the palette controlled. Start with neutral photography, then use one dominant accent color and optionally one secondary color to connect the modules, backgrounds and typography.

Small text should stay minimal. One series label and one short supporting line are enough. The poster should feel like a finished cultural, fashion or editorial visual rather than an event template.

Aim for strong contrast between crowded and quiet areas. Some parts can be dense with overlapping portraits and type, while another area is left open to give the composition room to breathe.

Keep faces realistic, skin natural, hair detailed and every person visually distinct.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【城市】：____
【城市面貌 A】：____
【城市面貌 B】：____
【A 侧代表元素】：____
【B 侧代表元素】：____
【A 侧主色】：____
【B 侧主色】：____
【主标题】：____
【英文副标题】：____

创作一张 9:16 高级城市概念海报，把同一座城市最有代表性的两种面貌、时代、地理或空间特征压进同一个画面。

画面建立两个彼此对望的城市世界：A 侧从画面一侧向中央密集生长，B 侧从另一侧向中央延伸，两侧拥有各自完整的建筑、道路、交通、人物和城市生活细节。通过夸张但可信的空间关系，让城市像从两个方向共同挤压、包围中央区域，形成强烈尺度感、纵深感和城市奇观。

两侧不能只是换颜色，而要通过建筑语言、时代特征、地理环境、交通方式、生活细节和光线真正体现【城市面貌 A】与【城市面貌 B】之间的关系。每一侧设置一个清晰的主视觉地标，其余城市元素逐级退后，形成近景、中景、远景和完整城市天际线。

中央保留一条较窄的天空、雾气、水域或城市裂隙作为视觉缓冲，两侧环境可适度伸入中央，使画面紧张但不混乱。整体采用高密度细节 × 清晰视觉层级，远看具有冲击力，近看能够发现有意义的城市信息。

标题【主标题】融入中央空间，字体设计应根据城市本身的性格重新设计，可参考碑刻、Art Deco、窄体城市字体、现代宋体或几何字体语言，而不是简单放置普通文字。只保留【英文副标题】等真正解释作品含义的信息，不加入随机英文、假参数、编号或无意义装饰文字。

保持写实城市质感与高级 Editorial Design 气质，建筑材质、道路、灯光、窗户、人物尺度和空气透视真实细腻；色彩由两种城市面貌的主题决定，在中央自然过渡。

重点：让海报首先是一件完整的城市视觉作品，每一个建筑、文字、色彩和细节都服务于城市主题，而不是模板化填充。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

生成一张 9:16 竖版高质量人物艺术海报，将一种“难以直接看见的自然现象或无形力量”转化成空间变化，让它直接参与构图。

主题：[热 / 雾 / 尘 / 磁 / 其他无形现象]
人物：[人物性别、年龄、服装、姿态]
主标题：[中文标题]
英文标题：[英文标题]
主色：[主色系]
空间变化：[折射 / 消隐 / 显现 / 偏转 / 扭曲 / 聚散等]

不要只是给人物加特效，而要表现这种无形现象如何真正改变周围空间：

热，可以通过空气折射、边缘轻微错位与背景弯曲，让空间产生波动；

雾，可以通过连续、柔和、半透明的层次逐渐抹去人物与环境边界；

尘，可以借助光束显现空气中原本不可见的细小颗粒，并产生自然悬浮与漂移；

磁，可以通过连续线条的弯曲、疏密变化与微粒排列，让看不见的力场显现方向。

人物必须真正处在这种空间变化之中，前景、人物、中景和背景要产生明确关系，不要变成“人物 + 背景特效”的简单叠加。

整体延续 Contemporary Asian Editorial Design / Museum Poster 气质：

暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸背景，细腻纸张纹理与轻微哑光印刷颗粒；真实自然的人物摄影质感；现代高对比中文 Typography + 优雅 Serif 英文标题 + 少量 Grotesk / Monospace 微信息；低饱和主题色，并用极少朱砂红作为系列视觉节点。

版面保持中高信息密度，同时保留约 20%–25% 有效留白。标题、人物与空间变化形成清楚的视觉层级。

所有辅助文字都围绕当前主题，可加入方向、距离、温度、光线、空气、边界等少量观察信息，不使用 Series No.、Visual Study、Composition 等模板化文字。

重点保证：

空气折射自然，不做夸张液化变形；
雾气连续、柔和、通透，不出现块状灰斑和脏污；
微尘细小、稀疏，只在光中被看见，不做闪粉或满屏颗粒；
磁力线连续顺滑，不做科技 HUD、霓虹能量线或科幻 UI；
人物皮肤真实自然，不过度磨皮、发光或油亮。

最终让观众第一眼看到完整人物海报，第二眼发现：真正组织画面的不是装饰，而是这些看不见的现象正在改变空间、边界与方向。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【诗词原句】：填写一句带有含蓄情绪与画面感的古诗词
【两字主题】：从诗句中提炼 2 个核心字
【核心情绪】：
【小主体】：
【主色体系】：
【浅压纹】：
【地点与日期】：

生成一张 9:16 竖版东方诗意留白艺术海报，将【诗词原句】中的【核心情绪】转化为一种可以被看见的情绪状态。

使用纯白或轻微冷调的高级手工艺术纸作为背景，保留真实纸纤维、纸浆颗粒和自然压痕。保持约 65%–75% 的有效留白，主体不要过大，【小主体】建议只占画面约 8%–20%，让空白本身参与表达距离、等待、记忆与未完成感。

不要直接复刻诗句中的完整场景，而是选择一个小而明确的物件作为情绪锚点，再通过颜色变化、消失、堆积、残影或运动路径表现情绪状态。

背景加入与主题有关的低对比浅浮雕【浅压纹】。压纹不能只是装饰，而要表现曾经存在、正在变化或尚未抵达的痕迹，例如逐渐上涨的旧水位、重复错位的蝶翼、褪色花影、飞过后的翼痕或延向远方的风线。远看保持干净，近看才发现隐藏的信息。

色彩使用【主色体系】，可以鲜明、漂亮、有情绪，不要因为主题忧伤就全部使用黑白灰。颜色应随着距离、时间或状态自然产生浓淡、褪色、透明或消散关系。

所有水线、丝线、风线、雨痕和运动轨迹必须连续、柔和、自然，避免大量断点、碎线和杂乱 AI 纹理。

可加入极小人物，但不是每张都必须出现。人物只用于建立尺度与情绪，不哭泣、不做戏剧化动作。也可以完全取消人物，让花、雨、蝶、鸟等小主体独立承担叙事。

中文主标题使用【两字主题】，采用现代宋体、明朝体或具有编辑感的中文衬线字体，可通过字距、轻微错位、细线或局部延伸增加设计感，但必须保证汉字完整、准确、清晰。

同时加入小字号诗句、地点、日期和简短英文标题。

整体效果应像古典诗词情绪、纸张材料实验、浅浮雕艺术与现代 Editorial Design 的结合：第一眼简洁、有留白，第二眼看到主体，近看才发现那些“没有说完”的痕迹。

设计一张具有现代东方编辑美学的文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」作为核心视觉方法。

背景使用温润、干净的暖象牙白手工纸，保留极轻天然纤维和细腻纸浆纹理。画面主动保留约 45%–60% 的大面积留白，让空白本身成为构图的一部分，不使用大量山水、植物、建筑或装饰元素填满背景。

使用【核心大色域】作为画面的第一视觉主体。大色域占据约 25%–40% 的画面，根据【海报主题】可以表现为幕布、嵌套层、长轴、薄纸、纸浆、器物结构或其他抽象大形，但不要直接做成普通写实物体。

大色域必须拥有真实而高级的手工纸材料感，包括天然长短纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、大尺度自然色差、轻微压痕、自然毛边与哑光表面。材质丰富但保持干净、完整，不做脏旧、黄斑、严重破损、随机斑驳、强噪点或廉价复古效果。

整体主色使用【主色调】，颜色数量保持克制。低饱和但色面必须完整、有浓度，不要把“东方感”理解成褪色、灰蒙或陈旧。可以设置一枚极小朱砂红印记或一个极小暖色节点作为点睛，总面积控制在画面 1%–2%。

在大色域附近加入一个尺度非常小但叙事完整的【微型文化场景】。人物、桌面、工具和器物整体只占画面约 3%–5%，让观者远看先看到大形和留白，靠近后才发现人物正在完成【核心动作】。

所有人物必须采用二维纸本淡彩插画语言，与整张海报使用同一种纸、同一套颜料和同一个画师般的视觉语言。人物面部只用少量克制线点概括五官，不刻画真实皮肤纹理、毛孔、眼球高光或摄影式面部阴影。

人物身体只使用轻微二维明暗表达基础体积，服装主要使用完整、低饱和、哑光的平面色块，仅加入少量连续自然的线性衣褶。人物脚下只保留非常淡的贴纸接触阴影。

禁止摄影真人感、3D 微缩模型感、CGI 体积感、塑料皮肤、电影光影、强轮廓光、摄影景深和强投影。人物必须像直接画在纸上的东方编辑插画。

根据主题加入少量【文化器物】，器物真正参与人物动作，不做整齐商品陈列，不堆满工作台。器物、人物与场景均保持纸本淡彩和轻工笔质感。

在微型场景和巨大主视觉之间建立一个清楚但克制的“尺度连接”。可以根据主题使用一根琴弦、操偶杆、纤维、漆线、纸边、工具轨迹或其他真实来源的细线，将微型手工行为视觉上连接到巨大色域。

连接元素必须有真实起点、完整走势和明确终点，不得漂浮、断裂或作为无意义装饰。

主标题【主标题】放在大面积留白区域，使用纤细、端正、具有现代东方文化机构气质的中文宋体或明朝体。标题保持中小尺度，不使用巨大 Typography，让文字成为第二视觉层级。

标题上方可加入极小英文活动类别，标题下方加入一行简短中文副题。日期、地点与活动信息使用更小字号集中排布在边缘留白区，形成真实文化海报的信息层级。

整体风格融合手工纸拼贴、水彩或矿物颜料肌理、二维纸本淡彩插画、微型文化叙事与现代东方编辑设计。

prompts.text:
Prompt：

【主题 / 作品名】：____
【核心内容】：____
【散点类型】：同类元素 / 实体物件 / 数字信息 / 碎片结构 / 图像与文字混合
【第一视觉锚点】：____
【辅助散点】：____
【主色调】：____
【强调色】：____
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有高信息密度、成熟 Editorial Graphic Design 与文化展览气质的散点构图海报。核心不是把元素随机撒满画面，而是建立多个大小、方向、密度不同的视觉锚点，再通过颜色、字体、间距、重复关系和隐形网格，把它们组织成一个完整作品。

整张画面设置约 4–7 个主要视觉锚点，并允许加入更多微型信息颗粒。必须保持明确主次：第一视觉锚点承担约 30%–40% 的视觉重量，第二、第三锚点明显次一级，其他元素作为小型散点穿插。通过至少 3 个尺度层级制造节奏：超大标题 / 主体 → 中型图像或物件 → 极小文字、数字、标签和细节，不要让所有元素尺寸接近。

根据内容选择合适的散点方式：同类元素可通过大小、方向、距离和局部裁切形成节奏，不做规则网格；实体物件利用不同轮廓、材质和视觉重量错落排列；数字、时间、坐标和数据可打散到不同区域，用字号与颜色建立跳读路径；碎片结构可围绕一个隐形整体排列，通过负空间、局部轮廓或纹样连续关系，让观众主动补全完整形态。

画面信息可以丰富，但不要平均分布。建议形成 2–3 个高密度区域、1 个中等密度区域，并保留至少 20%–30% 的安静空间。建立 3–4 条隐形纵向或横向基线，让标题、图片边缘、数字和标签在视觉上暗中对齐；允许主动打破网格，但必须先有网格逻辑。加入约 3–4 处有控制的穿插关系，例如文字局部被主体遮挡、图片压住标题边缘、标签与物件轻微叠压、色块或线条跨过不同信息区域。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要色系，不要平均使用颜色。确定一个主结构色，再让同一种强调色分散出现在不同区域，通过远距离颜色呼应把视觉散点重新连接起来。Typography 需要有明确层级：大型中文标题承担主要视觉重量，英文标题建立第二层结构，数字和日期可成为独立视觉锚点，正文与标签保持较小字号；允许横排、纵排、局部旋转和裁切，但不要随机旋转所有文字。

所有文字必须属于作品本身，例如时间、地点、材质、观察记录、作品短句、对象名称或相关数据，不出现“散点构图”“设计案例”“Visual Study”“Composition”“Series 01”等模板占位文字。最终第一眼应看到 1–2 个强视觉锚点，第二眼开始在不同散点之间跳跃，第三眼发现颜色、尺寸、方向和信息之间的呼应；放大后仍然有第二层、第三层细节可以阅读。

整体要求：高信息密度、杂而不乱、多锚点但主次明确、丰富、有节奏、有作品感，像成熟的艺术展览海报、独立出版物或 Editorial Poster。避免规则九宫格、平均撒元素、所有内容一样大、每个区域都塞满、PPT 信息块、无意义英文、过多边框、随机贴纸拼贴和主次不分。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

TITLE: [your word]  
PROJECT: [brand / exhibition / campaign]  
MATERIAL: [facade skin / elastic membrane / stone / plaster / earth / other]  
TRANSFORMATION: [peeling / swelling / erosion / cracking / other]  
HIDDEN LAYER: [color / material / none]  
ENVIRONMENT: [museum / outdoor plaza / desert / architecture / other]  
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]  
MAIN COLORS: [2–3 colors]  
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary material typography poster where the main word is physically generated by the transformation of the material itself.

Do not simply print or place the word onto the surface.

The typography should emerge through a real material process such as peeling, pneumatic expansion, erosion, cracking, splitting, melting, compression or another believable transformation.

The main title should occupy roughly 40–60% of the composition and remain bold, simple and highly readable at thumbnail size.

Use large-scale material changes rather than many small decorative details.

For peeling, let the outer surface physically lift, curl and separate to reveal a contrasting layer underneath, with the exposed areas forming the typography.

For swelling, let internal pressure push a continuous membrane outward so its inflated volumes and pressure valleys create the word.

For erosion, remove the outer material through wind, water or weathering so a contrasting inner layer is gradually revealed as readable type.

For cracking, let large fractures, broken edges and displaced surface pieces expose a contrasting internal material that forms the word.

The transformation should remain physically believable. Show realistic material thickness, tension, depth, shadows, exposed layers, deformation and surface behavior.

Keep the word integrated into one continuous material system. Avoid making each letter a separate 3D object.

Use one dominant material color, one strong contrasting revealed color, and a restrained architectural or natural environment.

The first visual impression should come from large color fields and a clear oversized word. The second impression should reveal how the material transformation actually creates the typography.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference. Their pose should feel natural and secondary to the installation.

Add only minimal editorial information such as project name, study title, location, date and one short conceptual line.

Overall style: material transformation, experimental typography, contemporary installation art, spatial graphic design, architectural photography, editorial poster, strong physicality, clear hierarchy and stop-scroll visual impact.

Avoid flat pasted text, ordinary 3D letters, random damage, excessive debris, weak material logic, tiny decorative details, neon sci-fi styling, cluttered environments, excessive filler copy, watermarks and numbering.

Prompt:

CITY: [TOKYO / NEW YORK / PARIS / DUBAI / YOUR CITY]
MAIN LANDMARK: [most iconic landmark]
OTHER LANDMARKS: [4–5 recognizable landmarks]
TYPE COLOR: [accent color]
FOREGROUND DETAIL: [cherry blossoms / taxi / leaves / palm leaves]
COUNTRY: [country name]

Create a 9:16 vertical city poster using iconic landmarks from the same city.

Treat each landmark as an independent architectural collage element rather than a realistic street scene. Place the landmarks around the edges of the frame using an extreme worm’s-eye perspective, with their forms rising and converging toward the center of the sky.

Use the MAIN LANDMARK as the central vertical anchor. Keep it the most complete and recognizable structure in the composition.

Arrange the other landmarks from the upper-left, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right edges. Make them large near the frame edges and gradually narrower toward the center, creating a strong radial, upward-moving composition.

Do not follow real geographic positions. The goal is to reconstruct the visual identity of the city through its landmarks.

Behind the architecture, place the city name in huge ultra-tall condensed sans-serif typography. The letters should occupy around 45–60% of the image, partially hidden behind the landmarks while remaining clearly readable.

Keep the city-name typography clean, solid and sharp. No distressed texture, cracks or worn lettering.

Use a limited three-color system: warm off-white paper background, charcoal / grayscale architecture, one strong accent color for the city name.

Render the landmarks with realistic architectural photography, then add subtle vintage editorial print texture, fine grain, halftone and paper texture.

Add a small blurred foreground detail connected to the city, occupying only around 5–10% of the lower edge, to create depth and local atmosphere.

Core visual formula:
iconic landmarks + extreme low-angle perspective + radial convergence + giant city typography + limited colors + subtle foreground depth.

The buildings, streets, and landscape MUST be built entirely from the inferred native ingredients. prompts.text:
I have done tons of food prompts in the past. This cutaway dish world concept is a bit different. each internal layer hosts a tiny scene of that ingredient being grown and cooked. An idea I plan to explore further in the future. 

I(0) = blank matte background.
I(1) = final isometric miniature world of $ DISH, its form cut straight through as silhouette $ SHAPE so the diorama IS a cross-section of the dish — every internal layer (crust, filling, broth, crumb) doubles as a terrain terrace hosting a tiny scene of that ingredient being grown, harvested and prepared.
∂I/∂t = Δ(I, $ DISH, $ SHAPE) along a recipe axis r, where build order follows the cooking steps r=0→1.
Constraints: isometric projection, faithful food cross-section anatomy, center-outward build order, ingredient-to-plate flow readable left→right, soft appetizing global illumination, edible-material shading (glossy, crumb, steam).
Integration:
t=0.0–0.15: faint isometric outline of the sliced $ DISH in silhouette $ SHAPE and a light guide grid appear.
t=0.15–0.4: the hero layer of $ DISH forms first at center (the signature filling/patty/core); primary strata block in as terraces.
t=0.4–0.7: each layer populates with its ingredient's mini-scene — fields, tiny farmers, mills, pots, chefs — and a small conveyor of the recipe threads through the layers in order.
t=0.7–0.9: the cut face resolves into a clean, mouth-watering cross-section; garnish and steam finalize the silhouette's edge.
t=0.9–1.0: soft shadows, tiny ingredient labels and step numbers appear, warm global illumination settles, final polish.
Output I(1) as an 8K isometric edible-cutaway diorama masterwork.

prompts.text:
GPT Image 2.5 is insanely good when you stop treating it like a “pretty picture” generator and start art-directing the optics. 👀📸

For this one I built everything around real mirror geometry, controlled reflections, hard light and optical fragmentation.
Just a fashion portrait that feels physically shot in-camera.

Full prompt below 👇
Create an extraordinary photorealistic cinematic fashion portrait. Vertical 4:5, full bleed, no typography.
An adult woman with olive skin, short black hair and a composed, penetrating gaze. She wears a minimal charcoal jacket with a sculptural collar. Her face is seen directly in the center of the composition, framed by three narrow mirror panels positioned at different angles close to the camera.

The central face remains complete and unobstructed. Each mirror reveals only a partial reflection: one eye at the far left, a fragment of jaw at the lower right, the back of her head near the upper edge. These are physically coherent reflections of the same person, not additional faces. Use the panels to create sharp silver diagonals around a calm central portrait.

One hard neutral-white spotlight strikes a mirror outside the frame, redirecting a concentrated patch of light across her eyes and upper cheek. A large, dim cool source supplies the base exposure. Black flags carve deep shadows along the jaw and collar.

The visible mirrors catch narrow white highlights, but their surfaces never become uniformly luminous. A single faint amber reflection appears on one panel, originating from a distant practical light.

85mm lens at eye level. Focus on the direct view of her near eye; reflected fragments soften according to their optical distance. Real skin pores, subtle under-eye texture, individual eyelashes, fine scratches visible only in bright mirror reflections.

Neutral skin, cold silver, charcoal and a trace of amber. Rich cinematic blacks, controlled specular highlights, subtle film grain. Sophisticated optical fragmentation achieved in camera.

No kaleidoscope filter, no duplicated central face, no broken glass touching skin, no impossible mirror geometry, no beauty smoothing.

made in @magnific

prompts.text:
I asked GPT to show me 4 tiny insects that are more dangerous than they look. 

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 famous rare insects that are more dangerous than they look: Prompt: Ultra-clean modern macro-biology infographic. Showcase a [SMALL INSECT/BUG] (e.g., jumping spider, praying mantis) in visually striking, hyper-detailed macro form—floating slightly in a 3D perspective or angled view. Arrange anatomical features, abilities, and habitat stats around the specimen in a dynamic editorial layout. Anatomy Section: Include glowing vector lines pointing to specific body parts (eyes, mandibles, legs) with mini-illustrations or microscopic scans detailing their function. Arrange them in a radial flow connected visually to the specimen. Behavioral Stats Section: Show abilities (jump height, venom toxicity, speed) with data graphs, numbered panels, or progress bars forming a logical flow around the main subject. Include small atmospheric icons (leaf, web, sun, moon). Additional Info (optional): Lifespan, ecosystem role, predation stats—displayed as clean futuristic holographic bubbles or badges near the specimen. Visual Style: National Geographic macro photography meets sci-fi bio-lab UI. Vibrant iridescent natural colors, subtle bioluminescent drop shadows, clean glowing vector lines, modern typography, soft dark gradients or frosted glass panels for data. Accent colors in neon cyan or green to highlight key stats. Composition Guidelines: Specimen as hero visual (angled, looking at camera). Data and anatomy flow dynamically around it. Clear visual hierarchy: bug > anatomy > stats. Enough negative space to keep design airy, mysterious, and readable. Lighting & Background: Cinematic rim lighting on the subject, dark minimal textured or gradient background (deep forest green or black) for a premium laboratory feel. Ultra-crisp, social-feed optimized, no watermark.

Another fun way to bring books and stories to life with GPT. Displays 4 scenes from a book. I came up with this for manga series but GPT can do it for anything really. 

Prompt: 16:9, do this for Shahnameh: function panel(AA){  <instruction>  Input A is a Famous Comic / Manga / Graphic Novel / Illustrated Series.    Analyze:  - line weight behavior, screentone logic, panel rhythm  - genre tension, iconic poses, emotional exaggeration  - signature symbols, motion language, typography mood  - creator’s visual fingerprint and page architecture  - era-specific print texture and publication culture    Goal:  An "Ink Bottle Flood."  A giant ink bottle has spilled across a drafting table.  The spreading black ink rises into sculpted 3D characters, panel borders, speed lines, environments, and iconic confrontations from the work.    Rules:  - the scene must remain tied to ink behavior: pooling, feathering, glossy thickness, edge bleeding  - include nibs, screentone sheets, correction tape, rulers, bristol board, speech bubble sketches  - include a tiny cartoonist at a miniature desk drawing the core scene  - include a serialized magazine headline, launch issue notice, or critical review clipping  - semantically infer publication era, genre tropes, and print-process texture  - no flat screenshot collage; make the manga/comic feel physically born from ink  - lighting: crisp overhead studio light with glossy black reflections    Output:  ONE image, 4:5, premium sequential-art process aesthetic  </instruction>    Output:  2x2 grid, each grid with a different panel(AA) output  }

画面信息可以丰富，但不要平均分布。建议形成 2–3 个高密度区域、1 个中等密度区域，并保留至少 20%–30% 的安静空间。建立 3–4 条隐形纵向或横向基线，让标题、图片边缘、数字和标签在视觉上暗中对齐；允许主动打破网格，但必须先有网格逻辑。加入约 3–4 处有控制的穿插关系，例如文字局部被主体遮挡、图片压住标题边缘、标签与物件轻微叠压、色块或线条跨过不同信息区域。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要色系，不要平均使用颜色。确定一个主结构色，再让同一种强调色分散出现在不同区域，通过远距离颜色呼应把视觉散点重新连接起来。Typography 需要有明确层级：大型中文标题承担主要视觉重量，英文标题建立第二层结构，数字和日期可成为独立视觉锚点，正文与标签保持较小字号；允许横排、纵排、局部旋转和裁切，但不要随机旋转所有文字。

所有文字必须属于作品本身，例如时间、地点、材质、观察记录、作品短句、对象名称或相关数据，不出现“散点构图”“设计案例”“Visual Study”“Composition”“Series 01”等模板占位文字。最终第一眼应看到 1–2 个强视觉锚点，第二眼开始在不同散点之间跳跃，第三眼发现颜色、尺寸、方向和信息之间的呼应；放大后仍然有第二层、第三层细节可以阅读。

整体要求：高信息密度、杂而不乱、多锚点但主次明确、丰富、有节奏、有作品感，像成熟的艺术展览海报、独立出版物或 Editorial Poster。避免规则九宫格、平均撒元素、所有内容一样大、每个区域都塞满、PPT 信息块、无意义英文、过多边框、随机贴纸拼贴和主次不分。

Prompt:

TITLE: [OPEN / ALIGN / PHASE / TURN / your own word]
PROJECT: [brand / exhibition / campaign name]
SPATIAL SYSTEM: [negative space / shadows / rotating panels / angled fins / other]
REVEAL MECHANISM: [viewpoint / light / alignment / rotation]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]
MAIN COLOR: [accent color]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where the main word becomes readable only when the spatial elements, viewpoint or light are correctly aligned.

The title should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition, but it must not simply be printed as normal text. Break the letterforms across physical structures so they appear fragmented or abstract from other viewpoints, then visually resolve into one clear word from the intended camera position.

For negative space, build the letters from openings cut through multiple architectural layers.
For shadows, let physical structures cast separate shapes that align into the word.
For rotating panels, split the typography across panels at different angles so they reconnect only at one precise phase.
For angled fins, distribute narrow slices of the word across repeated surfaces so the full title appears only from one viewing direction.

Keep perspective, scale, occlusion, lighting and geometry physically believable. The reveal should feel like a real installation rather than a digital overlay.

Use one strong accent color with a restrained architectural palette. Keep the typography bold, geometric and visually powerful when correctly aligned.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them as a scale reference or observer interacting naturally with the installation.

Add only a small amount of secondary editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, anamorphic installation, spatial graphic design, contemporary architecture, editorial poster, clean hierarchy and strong visual impact.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】  
【主视觉主体】  
【中文核心字】  
【中文标题】  
【英文标题】  
【对角机制】跨界变形 / 摄影转印刷 / 透明叠层 / 重复透视 / 其他  
【视觉状态变化】摄影→图形 / 彩色→单色 / 实体→折射 / 近大→远小 / 其他  
【主色】  
【强调色】  
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 **Experimental Japanese Graphic Design、East Asian Contemporary Poster、Editorial Art Direction、Photo Graphic Design** 气质的实验性竖版海报。核心继续使用“对角构图”，但不要只依靠一条斜线切画面，而是让主体、色域、透明层、重复元素或空间序列沿隐形对角轴发生变化，使对角关系本身成为视觉实验。

先根据【主题】选择一种最适合的对角机制。单一物件可以跨越两个色域，并在越过边界后从真实摄影转化为平面图形；植物、人物等有机主体可以穿越斜向色块，在不同区域改变颜色、网点或印刷状态；透明材质可以从近到远沿对角轴叠加，通过折射、遮挡和尺度变化建立空间；多个重复元素可以通过“近大远小、前后遮挡、姿态变化”沿斜轴推进，让观众在没有真实斜线的情况下仍然清楚感受到方向。

这类海报最重要的是“跨界以后发生什么”。至少设计一个明显但合理的视觉状态变化，例如真实摄影进入色域后变成丝网印刷剪影、同一物体经过透明层后出现折射错位、纸页沿对角方向由近到远逐渐缩小，或主体经过边界以后从彩色变成黑白。变化必须与构图产生因果关系，不要使用随机 glitch、RGB 分离或无意义特效。

对角色域要依赖大形而不是小装饰。可以使用两块高纯色域碰撞、一块大色域加窄负空间、透明板前后叠层，或大面积深色背景衬托重复对象。主体或主要视觉区域建议占画面约 50%–70%，颜色控制在 2–4 个主要层级，同一张只建立一个最强色彩关系。大胆使用群青、酸黄、朱红、深紫、冷白等现代印刷色，但不要平均分散颜色。

Typography 必须继续遵守“主体动，文字稳”。中文核心字、作品标题、英文标题保持水平或垂直，可大胆放大、贴边、裁切和跨区，但不要全部跟着对角线旋转。英文可以使用 Condensed Sans、Neo-Grotesk、Bold Serif 等现代字体，小信息使用 Neutral Grotesk。允许 Typography 与主体发生一处真实遮挡、穿插或前后关系，但必须保证标题仍然清晰可读。

可以适度加入 **halftone、screenprint、offset grain、轻微套印误差、粗网点摄影** 等印刷质感，使画面更像艺术书、独立出版、设计节海报，而不是普通数字海报。但不要做成朋克拼贴、撕纸、脏旧报纸或过度 grunge。画面要大胆、年轻、实验，同时保持清楚的大形和高级的版式控制。

信息密度保持中等。视觉复杂度主要来自主体状态变化、对角方向、色域关系、透明层或重复透视，而不是大量文字模块。至少保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，让高密视觉区域与安静区域形成节奏。辅助文字只保留标题、副标题、短句、日期、地点和 3–4 个主题关键词即可。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼先看到强烈的大色域或对角主体，第二眼发现主体跨界后的视觉状态变化，第三眼理解透明层、重复透视或摄影与图形之间的关系，最后才阅读标题和少量信息。整体效果应像东京实验设计展、独立艺术书、国际 Graphic Design 年鉴或高级 Editorial Art Direction，而不是普通产品广告或对角模板。

避免：只把主体斜着摆、标准 45° 分割、所有文字都倾斜、双色模板换皮、数字 glitch、RGB 色散、科技 HUD、PPT 时间轴、过多说明文字、无意义英文、Design Study、Vol.、编号、Logo、二维码和版权标识。
